title: Index 'Alleluia' rows (Easter weekdays, broken links) point to a rubric 'Psalmi cum Alleluia (in tonis diversis)', not an engraving: how to load?
prompt: Seven antiphon-index rows 'Alleluia' (chant_indices #514–520, rows 6176–6182: 2-7P2-7 Ol; 2-7P2-7 L 1 and L 3; 2-6P2-6 V 1 and V 2; 2-7P Hm; 2-7P C) have empty PDF links. The body has no engraving for them. It has the italic rubric 'Psalmi cum Alleluia (in tonis diversis).' On p280 ('B. Usque ad Ascensionem Domini — Pro cunctis diebus') it appears under Compl. and Hor. med. On p282 ('In officio feriali') it covers Off. lect. and Laudes 1/3, and p285 has 'Psalmus cum Alleluia' for Vespers 1/2. pp348–349 repeat these for the weeks after Ascension. So the psalms are sung under a plain 'Alleluia' antiphon in the psalm's own tone. There is no single melody to link. Row r6182 (Compline) was checked on p280.

pages.note: Compl. + Hor. med. 'Psalmi cum Alleluia (in tonis diversis)'
